name: popsicle
headline: InfoHub Marketing Materials Management
short_description: InfoHub is a Laravel-based system for managing marketing materials, providing user and admin panels, file management, search functionality, and detailed statistics to streamline content organization and access.
author: SaintAngeLs

sections.overview:
InfoHub is a Laravel-based marketing materials management system designed for dealerships and organizations that need centralized file organization and distribution. The platform provides separate user and administrator interfaces with permission-based access control, allowing users to browse and download files within their assigned categories while administrators manage menu structure, user groups, files, and dealership locations. Built-in search respects user permissions, and administrators can track downloads, logins, and page visits with customizable date ranges and automated monthly reports. The system supports file tagging, visibility scheduling, and email notifications for content changes, streamlining how teams access and manage marketing resources.
Dealership networks distributing marketing materials to regional salons with permission controls
Managing file downloads and tracking which users access specific content categories
Scheduling seasonal marketing materials with configurable visibility date ranges
Generating monthly reports on unused files and inactive users for content optimization
